concept:
Create one polished game-art concept comparison board for the existing indie pixel RPG BATTLE OF GODS. Three complete 16:9 title screens stacked vertically, separated by thin navy gutters and very small outside-panel headers A, B, C. This is one static ART DIRECTION BOARD, not animation frames or production UI.
Reference image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND PIXEL STYLE only: King is the compact chibi young sword wielder with spiky dark hair, warm orange scarf/cloth accents, cream small armor plates, dark trousers, brown gloves/boots, and his heavy silver sword. Keep his large head, short body, connected arms and readable silhouette; do not turn him into a photorealistic or adult-proportioned warrior. Reference image 2 is the existing bark/root humanoid Rotcaller. Reference image 3 is the existing small wooden Rootling. Use these as familiar ordinary enemy vocabulary, never introduce named gods, bosses, demon royalty or lore spoilers.
ART STYLE: high-quality restrained hard-pixel illustration with crisp dark contours, controlled pixel clusters, native-game-like pixel density, warm earthy browns/ochres/olive, cool charcoal midnight shadows and small magical accents. No painterly rendering, blur, gradients over characters, glossy mobile-game UI, ornamental huge frames or detailed cinematic realism. Dark and mysterious but lively and inviting.
Every panel uses the SAME clean menu design at the LEFT: left upper quadrant gold readable title BATTLE OF GODS, generous empty dark backdrop behind it; below title a discreet vertical menu with exactly CONTINUE, NEW JOURNEY, SETTINGS, QUIT. Simple slim text rows, small gold selection diamond beside CONTINUE, small quiet underline, no giant box. No subtitle, loading bar, gameplay HUD, duplicate menu, extra slogans or decorative central seal. King and the scene occupy the RIGHT 60 percent, slightly angled top-down/three-quarter pixel-game presentation with grounded feet, coherent lighting, no horizon or distant landscape. Keep a clear scene silhouette readable at 960x540.
A — THE QUIET BREACH: King on a worn stone approach at the lower right, silver sword carried on his shoulder, facing a small mysterious violet-blue upright breach among broken anonymous stone uprights. Two small Rootling silhouettes peek from shadow beyond the breach. A few root shapes and cold drifting motes. Anticipation and curiosity, not battle or a revealed deity. Most restrained and strongest recommendation.
B — EMBERS AND WATCHERS: King resting at the right beside a tiny warm campfire in a ruined stone shelter, sword safely planted beside him with hand nearby. One Rootling peeks from behind a low stone, a distant Rotcaller only partly visible in deep shadow. Cozy warm focal light and uneasy watchfulness. A few loose scarf pixels suggest breeze; ground stones stay coherent. Dark menu side.
C — THE FIRST CLASH: compact King at right in a clear strong sword-ready pose, two existing Rootlings approaching from lower right and distant root humanoid behind them; a tiny gold sword glint and displaced leaves sell anticipation. More adventurous energy, still controlled and mysterious, no epic armies, no gore, no giant enemies. Simple stone/soil court backdrop, not a forest panorama.
Make each composition meaningfully distinct, beautifully balanced, with readable native-looking menu placement and small expressive familiar characters. Reserve structural geometry for later stable layers; do not represent this static board as an animated result.
background:
Create a SINGLE 16:9 background-only pixel-art asset for a BATTLE OF GODS campfire title screen at intended native viewport 960x540. Reference image is a THREE-CONCEPT BOARD: use ONLY the MIDDLE B campfire scene as the composition/style inspiration, but rebuild it as ONE spacious full 16:9 frame.
Pixel style: dark crisp pixel clusters and decisive dark contours, limited earthy ochre/brown/olive, charcoal navy shadows, warm orange hearth light, no painted realism or smooth blur. Match a cute chibi action RPG with small actual sprite actors placed later. Three-quarter top-down view of an anonymous ruined stone shelter/courtyard at night, no horizon, no giant forest or distant landscape.
BACKGROUND ONLY. Remove ALL existing people, monsters, swords, actual flames, particles, banners with symbols, text, logos, UI, borders and option labels. No King or enemies baked into the image. These will be independent animated sprite layers in Godot.
The LEFT 38 percent is dark quiet negative space with barely visible grounded stone/soil texture behind real menu controls. Interesting environment predominantly on RIGHT: broken stone walls/upstanding pillars framing a modest worn shelter, one small barrel, restrained moss/roots and scattered loose stones, a low log/seat. Preserve clean actor floor areas.
Plan an empty unlit hearth at native pixel location approximately (710,405): small dark coal bed/logs only, with a fixed soft warm reflected light patch on the adjacent grounded stones/wall, but NO visible flames (separate animation layer will supply them). Open ground for King just left of the hearth at about (635,405). Narrow dark patches for two tiny watching enemies at about (880,300) and (590,278), with silhouettes NOT present yet. Keep those movement lanes uncluttered.
Structural stones and props must have coherent perspective and stable outlines. Intriguing, inviting, quiet and mysterious, warm safe foreground surrounded by cool darkness, no future boss/statue or story spoilers. There must be no letters anywhere.
flame:
Create ONE exact 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet, EIGHT sequential animation frames for a small magical-orange campfire flame in a crisp dark-outline pixel RPG. Reference image is ONLY the pixel style and warm campfire lighting reference, not an edit target. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no text, no labels, no border, no ground, no stone ring, no logs, no actors, no sparks outside cells.
Eight cells of exactly equal width/height, complete flame wholly contained with generous transparent gutters. Each frame has the SAME planted flame base at cell center x, y=80% cell height; no root translation, no scale change. Flames occupy about half cell width and half cell height. Coherent loop: frame0 leans left;1 rises;2 splits upper tips;3 folds right;4 leans right;5 contracts;6 lifts left;7 naturally bridges back to0. Flame tongues genuinely change connected shapes, do not copy the same flame eight times, do not rotate or translate the whole image. Base stays rooted; upper flame licks vary.
Colors dark warm outline, burnt orange outside, amber body, pale yellow inner core, a tiny near-white hottest center. Hard clustered pixel edges and binary transparent margins, no glow halo, smoke, blur, soft alpha, painterly gradients. Keep one clean identity, intensity/height in bounded range, readable in native64x64 cell. Intended sheet256x128 or exact proportional multiple.
